makkah.name: Makkah
makkah.description: Makkah is the setting for the Prophet’s ﷺ birth, the first revelations, the call, the persecutions and the preparation for the Hijrah. It later becomes the centre of pilgrimage again after the conquest.

jabal_al_nur.name: Jabal al-Nur (Cave of Hira)
jabal_al_nur.description: Mountain near Makkah housing the Cave of Hira, the site of his retreats and of the first revelation.

thawr.name: Cave of Thawr
thawr.description: Cave south of Makkah where the Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr hid during the Hijrah.

mina.name: Mina and Al-Aqabah
mina.description: Site of the meetings and pledges with the people of Yathrib during the pilgrimage season.

taif.name: Ta'if
taif.description: Taif is associated with the Prophet’s ﷺ journey seeking support and with the siege after Hunayn. The reports emphasize that the town was not taken during that expedition.

hudaybiyyah.name: Al-Hudaybiyyah
hudaybiyyah.description: Place near Makkah where the treaty of the same name was concluded.

quba.name: Quba
quba.description: Village on the outskirts of Madinah, the Prophet's ﷺ first stop on arrival.

madinah.name: Madinah (Yathrib)
madinah.description: After the Hijrah, Madinah became the centre of the first Muslim community. Related topics include the welcome of the emigrants, the mosque, communal agreements, prayer, expeditions and diplomacy.

uhud.name: Uhud
uhud.description: Mountain north of Madinah, site of the battle of year 3 AH.

badr.name: Badr
badr.description: Locality on the caravan route between Madinah and Syria, site of the first major battle.

abyssinia.name: Abyssinia (Aksum)
abyssinia.description: Abyssinia offered refuge to believers who left Makkah to escape persecution. The accounts highlight the audience before the Negus and the role of Jaʿfar ibn Abi Talib.

khaybar.name: Khaybar
khaybar.description: Oasis north of Madinah, site of the expedition of year 7 AH. Approximate position.

hunayn.name: Hunayn
hunayn.description: Valley near Makkah, site of the battle of year 8 AH. Approximate position.

wadi_al_qura.name: Wadi al-Qura
wadi_al_qura.description: An oasis region north of Madinah, associated with campaigns and agreements after Khaybar. Approximate map position.

mutah.name: Muʿtah (Jordan)
mutah.description: The Muʿtah region in Jordan, associated with the expedition of 8 AH. The map point identifies the modern locality, not the exact positions of the combatants.

al_abwa.name: Al-Abwa
al_abwa.description: A settlement on the historic route between Makkah and Madinah, traditionally associated with the death of Aminah, the Prophet’s ﷺ mother. Biographical accounts place the episode on her return journey from Yathrib. The map pin marks the modern locality and is indicative.

qiblatayn.name: Al-Qiblatayn Mosque
qiblatayn.description: A mosque in Madinah traditionally associated with reports about the change of prayer direction towards the Kaʿba. This commemorative identification does not mean that the present building is the seventh-century structure; the entry is a geographic reference.

arafat.name: Plain of Arafat
arafat.description: A broad plain east of Makkah and a central station of the pilgrimage. The standing (wuquf) takes place across the Arafat area; it should not be reduced to climbing Jabal al-Rahmah. The map pin marks one point within the plain.

dar_al_arqam.name: Dar al-Arqam
dar_al_arqam.description: House traditionally associated with the gatherings of the first Muslims in Makkah. Its exact location remains indicative.

safa_marwa.name: Al-Safa and al-Marwa
safa_marwa.description: Area of the two hills within the Sacred Mosque, a landmark for the saʿy during pilgrimage.

masjid_nabawi.name: Prophet’s Mosque
masjid_nabawi.description: Site of the mosque established in Madinah; the present building reflects many later expansions.

khandaq.name: Trench area
khandaq.description: Area traditionally associated with the defensive trench at Madinah. The exact historical line is approximate.

tabuk.name: Tabuk
tabuk.description: City in north-west Arabia and regional reference point for the Tabuk expedition.

muzdalifah.name: Muzdalifah
muzdalifah.description: Ritual area between ʿArafat and Mina on the pilgrimage route.
